(()=>{const names=['Fraktur','Pirata','Grenze','Cormorant','Italiana','Bodoni','Bebas','Orbitron','Gloock','Cinzel','Mincho','Metamorphous','Ink','Pixelify','Silkscreen','Press Start','Metamorphous','Young Serif','Philosopher'];const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('div,span')];const res={};for(const e of els){const tx=e.textContent.trim();if(names.includes(tx)&&e.children.length===0){res[tx]=getComputedStyle(e).fontFamily;}}return res;})()
